test the acos_linear_extrapolation function with a tensor containing values beyond the valid arccos domain
create a numerically stable arccos function using Taylor approximation for out-of-bounds tensor values
review the _acos_linear_approximation helper function which calculates the first order Taylor expansion of arccos
refactor the acos_linear_extrapolation function to support custom lower and upper bounds for the extrapolation region
convert quaternions with real part first to 3x3 rotation matrices using quaternion_to_matrix
convert 3x3 rotation matrices to quaternions with real part first using matrix_to_quaternion
convert Euler angles in radians to rotation matrices using euler_angles_to_matrix with a convention string
convert axis-angle vectors to rotation matrices using axis_angle_to_matrix where magnitude is the angle
convert 6D rotation representations to rotation matrices using rotation_6d_to_matrix with Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization
convert a batch of 6D SE(3) logarithmic vectors to 4x4 transformation matrices using se3_exp_map
convert a batch of 4x4 SE(3) transformation matrices to 6D logarithmic vectors using se3_log_map
compute the SE(3) V matrix from log rotation, hat, hat square, and rotation angles
compute the input variables needed for the SE(3) V matrix from a log rotation tensor
verify se3_exp_map and se3_log_map are inverses by converting a log transform to matrix and back
convert a batch of log-rotation vectors to 3x3 rotation matrices using Rodrigues formula
convert a batch of 3x3 rotation matrices to log-rotation vectors
calculate the relative angle in radians between two batches of rotation matrices
calculate the rotation angle in radians from a batch of 3x3 rotation matrices
convert a batch of 3D vectors into skew-symmetric 3x3 hat operator matrices
build a Transform3d object by composing scale, translate, and rotate transforms together
create a Transform3d and use transform_points to apply the transformation to a batch of 3D points
create a Transform3d and use transform_normals to transform a batch of normal vectors
test the RotateAxisAngle class to rotate points around the X, Y, or Z axis by a given angle
review the Transform3d inverse method to compute the inverse of a composed 3D transformation
